entities.summary: Brigadier Frederick Maurice Watson Harvey, VC, MC was an Irish-born Canadian recipient of the Victoria Cross, Canadian soldier and rugby union player. During the First World War, while serving in the Canadian Expeditionary Force, he was awarded the Victoria Cross, making him Canada's twenty-third recipient. He was also awarded the Military Cross and the French Croix de Guerre.
